card.name: Linking word after a place name
card.fires_on: The word or mark right after a city or place name that links it to an organization or publisher, such as '-based', 'native', or the colon in a citation. It responds in web text, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Place-based
modes.description: The hyphenated or standalone 'based' or 'native' after a city or region, introducing a group or person from there.

modes.label: Citation colon
modes.description: The colon after a place of publication in a bibliographic reference, before the publisher's name.

card.plain: It fires on the small link after a city name that leads into the organization or publisher, as in 'Boston-based' or 'Chicago: Press'.
